verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud's CLI extension can manage Service Accounts and API keys alongside Namespaces and Users, so a non-human identity with its own credential can be issued for an agent. Namespace isolation exists, but the evidence never shows keys or service accounts being scoped to specific Namespaces, permissions or roles. Missing for 10: documented least-privilege scoping of API keys or service accounts (per-Namespace or per-role permissions), expiry or rotation controls, agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
